## Twitter Workflow

**Purpose**: n8n workflow: Twitter Workflow. 4 nodes wired together. Uses: twitter, telegram, shopifyTrigger, stopAndError. Sourced from czlonkowski/Zie619 n8n-workflows community archive (workflows/Shopify/0085_Shopify_Twitter_Create_Triggered.json). Configure credentials and any hardcoded IDs before activating.

**Services needed**: twitter, telegram, shopifyTrigger, stopAndError

**Difficulty**: auto-deploy

**Setup**:
1. Configure credentials for the services above
2. Update any hardcoded IDs / URLs
3. Test with sample data before activating

_Source: https://github.com/Zie619/n8n-workflows_
